name: dnd-characters
description: MCP server for managing Dungeons & Dragons characters in Cloudflare D1. Use these tools to list, search, create, update, and delete characters. Each character has a name, class, species, level (1-20), and alignment. Characters are addressed by their 24-character hex character id; get an id from dnd_list_characters or dnd_search_characters before calling get/update/delete.
